purpose: Audit actual production quality/region scoring placement before family normalization; not relevance tuning or a representative geography test.
execution_gate: All original specification, independent corpus validation and parent execution approval gates, plus approval.supplementary_probe_spec_sha256 matching this complete file.
mapping: Existing production Scala exporter, dimension3; unchanged dataset analyzers and function-score builder.
resources: Unique owned magda-relevance-eval-* dataset index, region index and pipelines; delete only acknowledged exact created resources in finally. Never mutate regions27 or any existing user index.
retrieval_mode: Production radial minScore0.5; no topk substitution in this probe.

dataset_plan.identifier_rule: probe-{inside|outside}-q{0|1|2}; one record for every quality/geography combination

fixed_assertions: All six unique IDs included by each system and both query variants; exact total-hit count6 and Publisher-global/filter root count6 with one publisher bucket of count6; no timeout, failed shards or duplicates.

Production query contains weight1, quality field factor with hasQuality filter and missing1, score_mode sum; quality-only has no region function; spatial variant has weight1 filtered by actual preindexed geometry referencing only the newly owned region index/document/geometry field.

Raw boost1 removes only exact root dataset-vector boost; raw baseline score functions retained once, normalized candidates retain identical functions in both family branches before min-max normalization.
For baseline/raw_boost1/keyword/vector, quality-only scores divided by (1+quality) are equal for all six otherwise identical records, to relative/absolute tolerance1e-5.

For those same raw family controls, spatial scores divided by (2+quality) are equal within the inside group, and divided by (1+quality) equal within the outside group, tolerance1e-5. Do not presume equal unmultiplied inside/outside scores: production geographic augmentation also adds a text-plus-geometry matching branch.
All normalized candidate scores finite and within [0,1] to tolerance1e-5.

For boost1 normalized candidates, scores equal fixed weighted min-max fusion of the keyword-only/vector-only control scores over these six records, with OpenSearch 2.19.1's existing-control-demonstrated minimum normalized score0.001 (max(0.001,(score-min)/(max-min))), tolerance1e-5; candidates with retainedboost50 are recorded but not falsely predicted from the unboosted vector control.
measurements: One correctness response per system/query variant, not a latency benchmark. Retain actual exported requests, mapping/config hashes, per-hit scores/ranks, facet count projections, response hashes, structural checks, ratio/fusion residuals and exact resource cleanup status.
interpretation_limitations: Correctness fixtures use deterministic 3-dimensional vectors, not GTE relevance embeddings and not production OPA decisions.
A retained quality/spatial function is not proof of equivalent normalized final scoring. Min-max is applied after family-specific scoring and changes scale/placement.
The spatial query has production lexical/geographic matching effects in addition to the optional weight1 scorer; no isolated geography-relevance benefit is inferred.
Any assertion failure is persisted as failed evidence; do not tune query text, geometry, qualities, weights, expected IDs or tolerances after seeing the probe results.
